style: Grimdark gothic sci-fi oil painting, half-length portrait of a hooded machine-acolyte of a fanatical machine priesthood, centred, facing the viewer, from the waist up. Heavy ash-black and oxblood vestments with bone-white trim, frayed hems, layered over blackened iron and worn bronze augmetics. Where the face should be: a shadowed hood holding an iron or brass mask with glowing optic lenses, cables and ribbed tubes jacked into the hood, segmented mechanical tendril-arms rising behind the shoulders, wax seals with long parchment strips pinned to the chest, small bone memento mori skulls and reliquary charms on chains, a candle or censer smoke curling up. An open bronze ring with a gap at the top right hangs behind the head like a halo. Painterly brushwork, heavy chiaroscuro, single warm key light from the upper left, deep smoky background fading to black, incense haze, sombre, sincere, devotional, monumental. Original design. No text, no letters, no logos, no birds, no eagles, no wings, no emblem of a skull inside a cog, no floating skulls, no shoulder pauldrons, no power armour.

marshal.line: The Marshal, supreme commander of the order: tallest and most ornate, a crested iron helm-mask under the hood with a single slit of green light, a crimson horsehair plume, a tall command standard with hanging tally ribbons held in a mechanical hand, a heavy mantle of oxblood with bone trim, rank chains across the chest.

builder.line: The Builder: broad-shouldered, a riveted mason's mask with two green optics, a heavy bronze set-square and a plumb-bob on a chain, stone dust in the folds, one massive mechanical arm ending in a trowel and a hammer.

scout.line: The Scout: lean, a long hood with a narrow horizontal visor slit of pale light and a cluster of small telescopic lenses, a caged lantern on a pole, a rolled map case and a brass compass hanging on chains.

inquisitor.line: The Inquisitor, the doubter of all work: severe, very high collar, one huge brass magnifying lens over one optic, a cold blue-white glare, an iron rod of judgement, red wax seals of rejection pinned all over the chest, menacing and incorruptible.

scribe.line: The Scribe: a cowled mask with soft green optics, three mechanical arms each holding a quill over a floating unrolled scroll, ink-stained bone trim, inkwells on chains, scraps of vellum everywhere.

archivist.line: The Archivist: bent under the weight of chained books hanging from the shoulders, brass index tabs, a reading lamp hood over the optics, keys on rings, dust motes.

sentinel.line: The Sentinel: a tall tower-crested mask with a single red-amber optic, a heavy round shield and a long halberd, a lantern of warning, armoured robe, vigilant stance.

forgemaster.line: The Forgemaster, keeper of the kilns: soot-blackened, heat-blued iron mask with two furnace-orange optics, smith's tongs held by a mechanical arm, a glowing ingot, sparks and smoke, the robe hem singed, orange kiln light from below.

exorcist.line: The Exorcist, hunter of faults: a gaunt hooded mask with cold green optics, swinging a brass censer of grey smoke, a pale moth pinned under a glass dome on the chest, bone charms, ritual chains.

preceptor.line: The Preceptor, the teacher: calm and dignified, a domed mask with warm amber optics, a long pointer rod, a small lectern plate with an open book on the chest, a ring of students' candles.

herald.line: The Herald: a mask with a flared horn-bell vox grille for a mouth, a long bronze war horn, a hanging banner with abstract woven script, loudspeaker cones on the shoulders.

assayer.line: The Assayer: a precise mask with a jeweller's loupe optic, a bronze balance scale held by a mechanical arm with a single gold coin in one pan, ledger chains, a gold optic glow.

sculptor.line: The Sculptor: a half-carved clay-grey mask, chisel and mallet in mechanical hands, a small unfinished statue of a hooded figure held up, clay dust on dark robes.
